name: Green World Hotels Co., Ltd.
summary: Green World Hotels Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates hotels and restaurants in Taiwan. The company offers hotel room and catering, room accommodation, leasing and management services. The company was formerly known as Applied Vacuum Coating Technologies Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Green World Hotels Co., Ltd. in July 2015. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan. Green World Hotels Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of HIS Hotel Holdings Co., Ltd.
